atom.description: Resend's homepage opens with a 64px headline ('Email for developers') in white on near-black #0A0A0A, paired with a live code sample on the right showing a Node.js snippet of `resend.emails.send(...)`. The code panel has a Mac-window chrome (3 dots), syntax highlighting in muted Tailwind-style hues, and a subtle 'Copy' button on hover.
